# polytypo

> Locale-correct quotes, dashes, ellipses, hyphens and no-break spaces. One portable spec, five runtime implementations, byte-identical output — transform(input, { locale }) is pure, with no I/O, network access or global state.

polytypo is a typography rules engine, not a grammar or spell checker: it normalizes punctuation and spacing to the convention of a specific locale, and every rule cites its normative source (Chicago/Oxford, Duden, Imprimerie nationale, Kotus, Språkrådet, Мильчин). Spec 1.8.0, 19 locales (en-US, en-GB, de-DE, de-CH, fr, fr-CA, ru, fi, sv, el, es, it, pt-PT, pt-BR, nl, pl, uk, cs, tr), rules run in this fixed order: spaces, ellipsis, ranges, dashes, hyphen, quotes, apostrophe, symbols, nbsp.

Modes (4): text, html, markdown, yaml. `text` has no parser and no skip list — the whole string is prose to it. `html` and `markdown` parse the document and run the rules only on prose text nodes, never inside tags, attributes, character references, code spans or code blocks; `markdown` additionally requires an explicit `dialect` ("commonmark" or "mdx"), which is never detected, because one autolink is valid CommonMark and a parse error in MDX. `yaml` uses no parser either and is the one mode that skips by default: it processes only the values of the mapping keys named in its required `keys` option, which has no default, because nothing in YAML's syntax separates a prose `description:` from a shell command in `run:`. Whatever a mode does not process comes back byte for byte.

## Docs

- [Reference](https://polytypo.dev/docs/): API shape, options, the full error code contract, code examples for all five runtimes.
- [Error codes](https://polytypo.dev/docs/api/errors/): The eight stable polytypo error codes, when each is thrown, and why the code, not the message, is the contract.
- [Locales](https://polytypo.dev/locales/): per-locale coverage, each backed by a citation and a conformance fixture set.
- [en-US: English (United States)](https://polytypo.dev/locales/en-US/): English (United States) (en-US) in polytypo: quotes “…” and ‘…’, unspaced em dash for parenthetical breaks, 11 cited sources, 340 conformance cases.
- [en-GB: English (United Kingdom)](https://polytypo.dev/locales/en-GB/): English (United Kingdom) (en-GB) in polytypo: quotes ‘…’ and “…”, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 9 cited sources, 165 conformance cases.
- [de-DE: German (Germany)](https://polytypo.dev/locales/de-DE/): German (Germany) (de-DE) in polytypo: quotes „…“ and ‚…‘, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 7 cited sources, 89 conformance cases.
- [de-CH: German (Switzerland)](https://polytypo.dev/locales/de-CH/): German (Switzerland) (de-CH) in polytypo: quotes «…» and ‹…›, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 6 cited sources, 61 conformance cases.
- [fr: French](https://polytypo.dev/locales/fr/): French (fr) in polytypo: quotes «…» and “…”, spaced em dash for parenthetical breaks, 10 cited sources, 118 conformance cases.
- [fr-CA: French (Canada)](https://polytypo.dev/locales/fr-CA/): French (Canada) (fr-CA) in polytypo: quotes «…» and “…”, spaced em dash for parenthetical breaks, 9 cited sources, 40 conformance cases.
- [ru: Russian](https://polytypo.dev/locales/ru/): Russian (ru) in polytypo: quotes «…» and „…“, spaced em dash for parenthetical breaks, 6 cited sources, 89 conformance cases.
- [fi: Finnish](https://polytypo.dev/locales/fi/): Finnish (fi) in polytypo: quotes ”…” and ’…’, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 12 cited sources, 157 conformance cases.
- [sv: Swedish](https://polytypo.dev/locales/sv/): Swedish (sv) in polytypo: quotes ”…” and ’…’, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 10 cited sources, 154 conformance cases.
- [el: Greek](https://polytypo.dev/locales/el/): Greek (el) in polytypo: quotes «…» and “…”, no dash substitution for parenthetical breaks, 8 cited sources, 29 conformance cases.
- [es: Spanish](https://polytypo.dev/locales/es/): Spanish (es) in polytypo: quotes «…» and “…”, no dash substitution for parenthetical breaks, 10 cited sources, 23 conformance cases.
- [it: Italian](https://polytypo.dev/locales/it/): Italian (it) in polytypo: quotes «…» and “…”, spaced em dash for parenthetical breaks, 10 cited sources, 21 conformance cases.
- [pt-PT: Portuguese (Portugal)](https://polytypo.dev/locales/pt-PT/): Portuguese (Portugal) (pt-PT) in polytypo: quotes «…» and “…”, spaced em dash for parenthetical breaks, 8 cited sources, 19 conformance cases.
- [pt-BR: Portuguese (Brazil)](https://polytypo.dev/locales/pt-BR/): Portuguese (Brazil) (pt-BR) in polytypo: quotes “…” and ‘…’, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 8 cited sources, 19 conformance cases.
- [nl: Dutch](https://polytypo.dev/locales/nl/): Dutch (nl) in polytypo: quotes “…” and ‘…’, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 9 cited sources, 16 conformance cases.
- [pl: Polish](https://polytypo.dev/locales/pl/): Polish (pl) in polytypo: quotes „…” and »…«, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 9 cited sources, 16 conformance cases.
- [uk: Ukrainian](https://polytypo.dev/locales/uk/): Ukrainian (uk) in polytypo: quotes «…» and “…”, spaced em dash for parenthetical breaks, 8 cited sources, 18 conformance cases.
- [cs: Czech](https://polytypo.dev/locales/cs/): Czech (cs) in polytypo: quotes „…“ and ‚…‘, spaced en dash for parenthetical breaks, 8 cited sources, 19 conformance cases.
- [tr: Turkish](https://polytypo.dev/locales/tr/): Turkish (tr) in polytypo: quotes “…” and ‘…’, no dash substitution for parenthetical breaks, 11 cited sources, 30 conformance cases.

## Spec

- [Canonical spec repo](https://github.com/polytypo/polytypo): normative rules, locale data and conformance fixtures — runtime-agnostic, MIT licensed. An implementation is "polytypo" iff it passes this suite for the spec version it claims.
- [Modes contract](https://github.com/polytypo/polytypo/blob/main/spec/rules/modes.md): the normative document behind the modes above — the span model every mode shares, the round-trip guarantee, and each mode's skip list, including the specified scan `yaml` uses in place of a parser.
- [Conformance matrix](https://github.com/polytypo/polytypo/blob/main/spec/CONFORMANCE.md): which runtime claims which spec version, and where a runtime's claimed scope is narrower than the full spec.

## Optional

- [Manifesto](https://polytypo.dev/manifesto/): why this is typography, set by locale convention long before language models existed, not an AI watermark.
- [Changelog](https://polytypo.dev/changelog/): what changed in each released spec version, with the before-and-after of every behaviour change.
- [Sites using polytypo](https://polytypo.dev/showcase/): sites that show the polytypo badge.
